يجتلوا (form VIII)
# يَجْتَلُوا (yajtalū) /jad͡ʒ.ta.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# يُجْتَلَوْا (yujtalaw) /jud͡ʒ.ta.law/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
